program.title: WELDING PROGRAM
program.description:
The Wilco Welding Program is intended to prepare students for the requirements of an entry-level welding technician or apprenticeship in the Skilled Trades. Students will be oriented to a career pathway and begin developing Workplace Skills, Worksite Safety, Technical Knowledge, and Hands-On practice. Upon completion of the Program, a graduate should be able to obtain an apprenticeship or entry-level position in a Manufacturing, Fabrication or Building Trades sector.

In order to prepare students for their role as a Welding Technician, they will participate in in-depth classroom discussions of OSHA Safety Standards, Welding Terminology, Precision Measurements, Welding Symbols & Blueprint Reading, Industry Codes & Documents, Welding Equipment, Welding Theory, and workplace skills such as Continuing Education and Professional Development, résumé development, job searches, and interview practices.

Students will also participate in Shop Activities where they will learn how to use hand and power tools and welding equipment. Our lab curriculum covers Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW), Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW), Oxy/Fuel Cutting (OFC), Plasma Arc Cutting (PAC), Air/Carbon Arc Gouging (CAG-A), brazing, and soldering.
features: Learn safe work habits, OSHA standards, and proper shop procedures.
Build technical knowledge of welding terminology, theory, equipment, and industry documents.
Use precision measurements, welding symbols, shop drawings, and blueprint reading.
Practice safely using hand tools, power tools, and welding equipment.
Train with SMAW (Stick), GMAW (MIG), oxy/fuel cutting, plasma cutting, gouging, brazing, and soldering.
program.homeSummary: Wilco Welding prepares students for entry-level welding technician positions and skilled-trades apprenticeships. Students build workplace safety, technical knowledge, and hands-on experience with industry tools and welding processes while preparing for careers in manufacturing, fabrication, and the building trades.
